rooms.1: A dismal swamp: dark murky water with lily pads and purple flowers, dead grey trees on the far bank, a low grey mist, a small muddy hummock in the foreground. The middle of the scene is open water and mud.
rooms.2: View from the top of a tall cypress tree: a massive trunk and spreading branches with clumps of green needles, a bright blue sky with a white cloud, the swamp far below.
rooms.3: Inside a damp hollow tree stump: curved walls of dark wet wood around the viewer, a circle of grey sky high above, a dark hole in the soft floor, a small blank wooden sign (no writing) on the wall.
rooms.4: A root chamber under a tree stump: gnarled tree roots twisting through earthen walls and ceiling, a dark hole in the back wall, a bare earth floor.
rooms.5: A semi-dark hole by a root chamber: a rough earthen cave lit dimly from one side, gnarled roots overhead. The far earth wall is bare and flat in the middle, with NO door, no opening, nothing on it.
rooms.6: A long hall sloping down underground: stone walls in perspective, worn steps descending into darkness, faint torchlight.
rooms.10: The shore of a clear blue lake on a sunny day: gentle waves, distant green hills, a sandy beach, a small blank wooden sign on a post (no writing).
rooms.11: A deep green forest: tall straight tree trunks and a dense leafy canopy, ferns and grass on the forest floor, dappled light.
rooms.23: A sunny meadow of bright green grass and wildflowers under a blue sky with a fluffy cloud, a tree at the right edge, a small blank wooden sign on a post (no writing). The centre of the meadow is open grass.
rooms.24: Death: a grinning red devil with horns and a pointed tail, holding a pitchfork, standing before roaring orange flames.
rooms.25: A hidden grove: a sheltered clearing ringed by dark green trees, a single fruit tree in the middle, a small blank wooden sign (no writing).
rooms.26: A quick-sand bog: a wide pool of glistening tan quicksand surrounded by reeds and dark green trees under a grey sky.
rooms.28: View from the top of an oak tree: leafy branches in the foreground, to the east a sunny meadow and beyond it a blue lake glinting, a blue sky.
rooms.29: The edge of a BOTTOMLESS hole: a huge round black pit in a grassy field, a large blank billboard on posts beside it (no writing), blue sky.
rooms.30: A narrow rock ledge just below the rim of a bottomless hole: dark earthen walls, a sliver of sky above, infinite blackness below.
rooms.32: An endless corridor: a wooden corridor of repeating door frames receding forever into darkness, in perfect one-point perspective.
rooms.33: A large misty room with a high ceiling, three dark arched exits across the far wall, curious carved symbols above each arch, purple mist drifting across a pale stone floor.

items.2: A clay pot overflowing with glittering red rubies.
items.3: A large spider web stretched between twigs, with a fat spider in the middle.
items.4: A felled tree: a hollow stump with the long trunk of the fallen cypress lying beside it.
items.5: A tall cypress tree with a thick trunk, flared roots and dense green needle foliage.
items.7: A patch of thick, foul-smelling black mud with bubbles.
items.11: A rusty old woodcutter's axe with a wooden handle.
items.14: A large iron ring of old skeleton keys.
items.16: A heavy, locked wooden door with iron bands and a big keyhole, in a rough wooden frame.
items.17: An open wooden door in a rough frame, a dim hallway beyond.
items.18: Wisps of pale green glowing swamp gas drifting low.
items.22: Patches of oily, iridescent black slime on the ground.
items.27: A large green-scaled dragon curled up asleep, wings folded, a curl of smoke from its nostrils.
items.28: A flint stone and a steel fire-striker.
items.42: A small swarm of tiny red chigger mites.
items.46: A magical fruit made of glittering jewels: a golden apple studded with gems.
items.47: A small statue of a blue ox on a little stone plinth.
items.55: A dead fish lying on its side.
